problem: Powerhouse had strong Company Intelligence, autonomous-improvement, quality and engineering-learning capabilities, but lacked one explicit cross-layer contract joining agent objectives, model routing, architecture health, evaluation/promotion and learning compilation into a single compounding intelligence loop.
root_cause: Capabilities existed across separate canonical subsystems without one explicit self-improvement authority and measurable north-star contract.
decision: Add a thin Self-Improvement Layer that composes existing authorities rather than creating parallel stores or schedulers.
prevention: Every agent must expose a measurable objective plus guardrails.
Every material candidate must pass evidence, quality, security and regression gates.
Architecture health participates in promotion decisions.
Learning compiles into regression, skill, documentation, system-map and bounded candidate outputs.
No learning path may directly rewrite production.
title: Powerhouse self-improvement cross-layer authority
impact: Without one explicit cross-layer contract, learning quality, model selection, architecture health and agent objectives could improve locally without proving that Powerhouse as a whole became better.
failed_approaches: Adding more isolated agents or AI features without a shared outcome/evaluation authority.
Treating code presence or model novelty as proof of improvement.
fix: Compose existing Company Intelligence, quality, autonomous-improvement and protected-delivery authorities behind one evidence-first Self-Improvement Layer.
prevention_rule: Every material autonomous improvement must have explicit objective, verified evidence, representative evaluation, regression/security non-degradation and protected promotion. Unknown is never green and learning may not directly rewrite production.
outcome: Candidate unifies evidence-backed daily compounding across company, agent and engineering learning without creating a parallel truth or production writer.

invariants: candidate promotion requires quality security and regression gates
model routing respects privacy and capability boundaries
